title: Disappointed
text: Disappointed. I'm not sure what people are doing wit this thing, I was hoping it would clean floors? I can see this cleaning floors that have already been cleaned and you want to disinfect and steam it to get an overall even cleaner clean. It does not work on dirty floors, you know, people walking in without the cleanest shoes kind of clean. I vacuumed the floor to get rid of any lose dirt and was hoping the rest would be done by the steam cleaner. I guess that is not how it works, you deep clean the floors with some other cleaning option and you only steam it for a final extra deep clean? I didn't have super dirty floors, not sure how this would even do on muddy paw prints? I felt it was useless for me, since the mop picked up some dirt, the floor was wet, but wasn't cleaned. I wiped over it with a paper towel and had more success doing that. Sorry, will return and look for something else.
